## R Markdown

# Copy Paste the whole page of PFF data into the appropriate sections

```{r}
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
```
#The functions
```{r}

library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

parse_pff_block <- function(
  teams_text,
  stats_text,
  year,
  metric_names = c("Overall","Offense","Passing","Pass_Block","Receiving","Running",
                   "Run_Block","Defense","Run_Defense","Tackling","Pass_Rush",
                   "Coverage","Special_Teams"),
  verbose = FALSE
)
{
  n_metrics <- length(metric_names)

  # 1) Teams (one per line)
  teams <- str_split(teams_text, "\n")[[1]] |> str_trim()
  teams <- teams[teams != ""]

  # 2) Clean stats text: remove noise; collapse W-L to one token like 4_1
  s <- stats_text |>
    str_replace_all("Team\\s+Reports", " ") |>
    str_replace_all("(\\d+)\\s*[-–—]\\s*(\\d+)", "\\1_\\2")

  # 3) Keep ONLY W-L tokens and numbers
  tokens <- str_extract_all(s, "\\d+_\\d+|\\d+\\.\\d+|\\d+")[[1]]
  is_record <- function(tok) grepl("^\\d+_\\d+$", tok)

  # 4) Parse ALL blocks in sequence, independent of team names
  blocks <- list()
  p <- 1L
  while (p <= length(tokens)) {
    # seek next record
    while (p <= length(tokens) && !is_record(tokens[p])) p <- p + 1L
    if (p > length(tokens)) break

    wl <- str_split_fixed(tokens[p], "_", 2); p <- p + 1L
    wins   <- as.integer(wl[1])
    losses <- as.integer(wl[2])

    # PF / PA
    if (p + 1L > length(tokens)) break
    PF <- as.numeric(tokens[p]); p <- p + 1L
    PA <- as.numeric(tokens[p]); p <- p + 1L

    # up to n_metrics grades (stop early if next token looks like a record)
    grades <- numeric(0)
    while (p <= length(tokens) && !is_record(tokens[p]) && length(grades) < n_metrics) {
      grades <- c(grades, as.numeric(tokens[p])); p <- p + 1L
    }
    # pad missing trailing metrics (e.g., missing Special Teams)
    if (length(grades) < n_metrics) {
      if (verbose) cat(sprintf("Padded block %d: found %d/%d metrics\n", length(blocks)+1, length(grades), n_metrics))
      grades <- c(grades, rep(NA_real_, n_metrics - length(grades)))
    }

    blocks[[length(blocks) + 1L]] <- c(wins, losses, PF, PA, grades)
  }

  # 5) Align blocks to teams (first k blocks to first k teams), pad extras with NA
  k <- min(length(teams), length(blocks))
  if (verbose) cat("Teams:", length(teams), " Blocks:", length(blocks), " Aligning:", k, "\n")

  # rows for the aligned portion
  rows_aligned <- lapply(seq_len(k), function(i) c(teams[i], year, blocks[[i]]))

  # rows for any leftover teams (no data in that year) -> all NA stats
  if (length(teams) > k) {
    na_row <- c(NA, NA, rep(NA_real_, 2 + n_metrics))  # wins,losses,PF,PA + metrics
    rows_pad <- lapply((k+1):length(teams), function(i) c(teams[i], year, na_row))
    rows <- c(rows_aligned, rows_pad)
  } else {
    rows <- rows_aligned
  }

  # 6) Build tibble
  cols <- c("team","year","wins","losses","PF","PA", metric_names)
  df <- as_tibble(do.call(rbind, rows), .name_repair = "minimal")
  names(df) <- cols

  df %>%
    mutate(
      year   = as.integer(year),
      wins   = as.integer(wins),
      losses = as.integer(losses),
      PF     = as.numeric(PF),
      PA     = as.numeric(PA),
      across(all_of(metric_names), as.numeric)
    )
}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# clean a team-name column in any df
normalize_team_names <- function(df, col = team) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      {{ col }} := {{ col }} %>%
        str_replace_all("\\uFEFF", "") %>%     # BOM
        str_replace_all("\\u00A0", " ") %>%    # non-breaking space
        str_replace_all("[\\r\\n\\t]", " ") %>%# CR/LF/tabs
        str_squish()                           # collapse + trim
    )
}
```

```{r}
pff_all_years <- bind_rows(pff_2014, pff_2015, pff_2016, pff_2017, pff_2018, pff_2019, pff_2020, pff_2021, pff_2022, pff_2023, pff_2024, pff_df_2025)
```

```{r}
clean_team_names_pff <- function(pff_all_years) {
  pff_all_years <- pff_all_years %>%
    mutate(
      team = case_when(
        team == "UT San Antonio" ~ "UTSA",
        team == "Appalachian State" ~ "App State",
        team == "UMass" ~ "Massachusetts",
        team == "Southern Mississippi" ~ "Southern Miss",
        team == "Connecticut" ~ "UConn",
        team == "Louisiana-Monroe" ~ "UL Monroe"
      )) %>%
    filter(team != "James Madison") %>% 
    filter(team != "Jacksonville State") %>% 
    filter(team != "Sam Houston")
  
  return(pff_all_years)
}
write.csv(pff_all_years, file = "pff_team_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
